claim: Marina Bay Sands is a 2,500+ room resort that can feel impersonal at scale.
quote: with over 2,500 rooms and a resort-like scale, Marina Bay Sands can feel impersonal

claim: The rooftop infinity pool is guests-only, heavily photographed and crowded at sunset.
quote: the rooftop infinity pool is one of the most photographed pools in the world, so expect crowds and limited space, especially during sunset hours

claim: Expect roughly S$1,400 per night for a Marina Bay Sands room at peak.
quote: you should expect to spend approximately S$1400 (US$1035) for a hotel room per night

claim: Raffles Singapore is an 1887 colonial grande dame, the birthplace of the Singapore Sling.
quote: Raffles Hotel Singapore: Book Luxury Hotel Experience

claim: Raffles is all-suite (115 suites) with teakwood floors and antique-filled Presidential Suites.
quote: romantic studios with garden views and palatial Presidential Suites with antiques, teakwood floors and fascinating memorabilia

claim: Raffles rates start around S$770; cheapest deals tend to fall in June and August.
quote: Rates start from $769 on KAYAK ... The cheapest deals can generally be found in August and June

claim: Capella Singapore sits on a Sentosa hillside as a 5-star colonial-meets-modern resort.
quote: 5 Star Hotel in Singapore | Capella Hotel Singapore

claim: Capella pairs restored 1880s Tanah Merah colonial bungalows with a Foster + Partners steel-clad structure; rates from ~£740; dining by 3-Michelin-star La Dame de Pic.
quote: two restored Tanah Merah colonial bungalows dating back to the 1880s ... Architects Foster + Partners ... Rates start from approximately £740 per night ... La Dame de Pic's three Michelin stars

claim: Capella Singapore is listed as a Sentosa Island luxury hotel.
quote: Capella Singapore hotel | Sentosa Island, Singapore

claim: The Warehouse Hotel is a boutique heritage hotel at Robertson Quay.
quote: Boutique Heritage Hotel in Robertson Quay, Singapore

claim: Built in 1895 as a riverside godown amid secret societies and distilleries; restored by local agency Asylum with louvre windows and a pulley-and-wheel lobby light.
quote: The Warehouse Hotel was built in 1895 along the Singapore River ... a hotbed of secret societies, underground activity, and liquor distilleries ... the award-winning local agency Asylum ... a custom-made light in the lobby made of wheels and pulleys

claim: The Warehouse Hotel rates start from about S$271 per night.
quote: prices start from $271 per night for 1 night, including fees but not including taxes

claim: Reviewers describe a reclaimed godown with industrial restraint that 'holds its posture'.
quote: a reclaimed godown and behaves like a place that remembers what it used to be, with a certain industrial restraint ... just holds its posture

claim: 21 Carpenter occupies a 1936 remittance house; immigrants' notes are laser-cut into the metal facade; restored by WOHA.
quote: a notable remittance house ... founded in 1936 ... nostalgic words and phrases have been lifted from the historical record and laser-cut into the metal facade ... Restored by award-winning architects WOHA

claim: 21 Carpenter draws highly positive reviews; Marina Bay is about a 10-minute walk.
quote: Marina Bay can be reached within a ten-minute walk

claim: 21 Carpenter is a Michelin Guide hotel.
quote: 21 Carpenter - Singapore - Book a MICHELIN Guide Hotel

claim: Six Senses Maxwell joins fourteen 1929 Art Deco shophouses on a former nutmeg plantation, styled by Jacques Garcia as the sibling to Six Senses Duxton.
quote: Six Senses Maxwell occupies the site of a former nutmeg plantation and features 14 ... colonial-style buildings ... built in 1929 with an Art Deco frontage ... the refined European aesthetic of French designer Jacques Garcia

claim: Guests praise Six Senses Maxwell's decor and history but note small rooms.
quote: highlighting the unique decor and historical value ... some reviews pointed out issues with room size

claim: Mondrian Singapore Duxton is set in the heart of Duxton Hill.
quote: Mondrian Singapore Duxton | Modern Luxury | Mondrian Hotels

claim: The 302-room hotel uses a 'deconstructed shophouse' concept of arched walkways and reimagined shutters.
quote: the overarching 'deconstructed shophouse' design concept - think arched walkways, reimagined shutters ... the 302-room property

claim: Rooms start around S$220; the rooftop Canyon Club pool overlooks Chinatown's terracotta roofs.
quote: Rooms typically start around $220/night ... the rooftop infinity pool ... a 360-degree backdrop of the glittering Singapore skyline and the terracotta rooftops

claim: Hotel Mono is a monochrome boutique hotel set in restored Chinatown shophouses.
quote: Singapore Boutique Hotel | Hotel Mono | Chic Hotel Singapore

claim: Set in six shophouses retaining air wells and Rococo windows; ~S$124; thin walls noted.
quote: set in six historical shophouses ... retain their original charm with characteristic air wells and Rococo-era windows ... paid $124 SGD ... the sound barrier wasn't good enough

claim: AMOY is entered via the Fuk Tak Chi Museum (a former temple, Singapore's first street museum); 37 rooms inspired by Zhangzhou/Amoy settlers.
quote: step into AMOY Hotel via Fuk Tak Chi Museum, Singapore's first street museum that was formerly a temple ... inspired by the Zhangzhou people ... With just 37 guest rooms

claim: AMOY averages about US$149 and greets guests by name.
quote: The average price is 149 USD ... greeting every guest by name

claim: The Clan Hotel is a modern luxury hotel in Far East Square.
quote: The Clan Hotel Singapore | Modern Luxury Hotel | Official Site

claim: A 30-storey bronze tower themed on Chinese clan associations, with a welcome tea ceremony and precinct tours.
quote: pays tribute to Singapore's Chinese clan associations ... At 30-storey tall, the sleek and modern bronze building ... a welcome tea ceremony

claim: Ann Siang House is a restored heritage shophouse on Ann Siang Road with a co-living concept.
quote: Housed within a beautifully restored heritage shophouse on prestigious Ann Siang Road ... a unique co-living experience

claim: PARKROYAL Collection Pickering is a Chinatown garden hotel with extensive sky gardens.
quote: Eco Friendly Hotel Singapore | PARKROYAL COLLECTION Pickering

claim: WOHA designed it as a 'hotel-as-garden' with 15,000 m2 of tiered sky-gardens, pools and cascading greenery.
quote: designed as a hotel-as-garden ... 15,000 square metres of lofty four-storey tall sky-gardens, reflecting pools, waterfalls, planter terraces and cascading vertical greenery

claim: The greenery exceeds 200% of the site's land area; the building uses solar cells, motion sensors and rainwater harvesting.
quote: lush foliage constitutes more than 200% of the total land area ... designed to consume minimal energy with the use of solar cells, motion sensors, rainwater harvesting and reclaimed water

claim: Andaz Singapore's Mr Stork is a rooftop bar with teepee huts and panoramic 360-degree city views.
quote: an alfresco and dining rooftop bar in Singapore with 10 teepee huts and panoramic city views ... 360-degree vistas

claim: Andaz sits at the crossroads of Kampong Glam, Little India and Bras Basah; rooms ~S$374–468.
quote: at the crossroads of Kampong Glam, Little India ... the cheapest price a room ... was $374, while the most expensive was $468

claim: 2026 reviewers praise the Mr Stork rooftop for views and glamour without overcomplication.
quote: praised how the hotel does not overcomplicate the experience, letting you go up, look out, order something, and feel the glamour

claim: The Vagabond Club is a 41-room 1950s Art Deco hotel with Asia's first Jacques Garcia interiors and a brass rhino reception.
quote: housed in a 1950s heritage Art Deco building and designed by the world-renowned French designer Jacques Garcia

claim: Garcia's 'all things in excess' interiors include a life-sized brass rhino sculpted over eight months and a 1,000-bottle Whiskey Library.
quote: a gleaming brass life-sized Rhino sculpture ... took eight months to create ... The Whiskey Library boasts a choice of 1,000 rare and unique whiskeys

claim: The Serangoon House is a Jacques Garcia homage to Indian colonial architecture with custom double-tiered canopy beds, family-oriented.
quote: a lavish homage to Indian colonial architecture, designed by the legendary Jacques Garcia ... custom-built, double-tiered canopy beds, handcrafted in Europe

claim: The Serangoon House is a boutique hotel in Little India.
quote: The Serangoon House Hotel

claim: Wanderlust is housed in a conserved 1920s Art Deco building in the Jalan Besar / Little India area.
quote: housed within a beautifully conserved 1920s Art Deco building in the vibrant Jalan Besar neighbourhood

claim: Each of Wanderlust's four floors was designed by a different firm; rooms include Pantone single-colour and black-and-white 'paper' themes.
quote: Each level of this four-floor hotel was given over to a different design firm ... the pantone-themed second level ... the mostly black-and-white third level features rooms inspired by the theme of paper

claim: The Sultan spans 61 rooms across 10 early-1900s shophouses including the old Al-Ahmadiah Press building, with shutters and tall columns.
quote: 61 unique rooms crafted from a collection of iconic early-1900s shophouses, including the old Al-Ahmadiah Press Building ... full-length shutter windows and tall columns

claim: Couples rate The Sultan 8.8; nightly rate around S$104; sound insulation is a heritage caveat.
quote: Couples particularly like the location - they rated it 8.8 ... The nightly rate at The Sultan is typically $104 ... challenges with sound insulation

claim: Coliwoo Kampong Glam opened May 2025 at 48 Arab Street with a Malay-textile-referencing facade and complimentary heritage tours.
quote: Opened in May 2025 ... located at 48 Arab Street, with a geometric facade that references traditional Malay textiles ... complimentary heritage tours for guests

claim: Heritage Collection is a boutique aparthotel in Kampong Glam with loft-style living and smart-room tech.
quote: a distinctive rosy pink facade ... loft-style living and a private garden ... smart room technology

claim: Nostalgia Hotel is a boutique heritage hotel in Tiong Bahru with individually furnished, period-styled rooms.
quote: charming and elegant boutique hotel conveniently located in the heart of Singapore's oldest estate Tiong Bahru ... original-themed art decor

claim: Lloyd's Inn is a 34-room minimalist hotel near Orchard, with a secret-garden setting, dip pool and hanging chairs.
quote: Tucked behind high hedges in a quiet residential neighborhood ... a real secret garden feel ... a small pool, big enough for dipping

claim: Lloyd's Inn earns rave reviews for cleanliness and design; staycation packages from ~S$189.
quote: earns rave reviews for its cleanliness ... modern, well-designed rooms

claim: Mandai Rainforest Resort offers 24 seed-pod-shaped 63 m2 treehouses elevated in the canopy.
quote: 24 luxurious treehouses, shaped like seed pods and elevated high above the ground, these 63sqm havens offer a unique canopy living experience

claim: Mandai is Singapore's first Super Low Energy eco-resort; reviewers say you forget you're still in Singapore.
quote: Singapore's first Super Low Energy eco-resort ... the whole place feels like stepping into another world and you really do forget you're still in Singapore

claim: Equarius TreeTop Lofts are one-bedroom villas 12 m up in native canopy with terrace decks, at Resorts World Sentosa.
quote: a private hideaway 12 metres up in a canopy of native trees with exclusive one-bedroom treehouse villas ... terrace decks where you can breakfast with the birds

claim: Into the Woods is a slow-living beach glamping experience on Lazarus Island.
quote: Into the Woods: Glamping Experience in Singapore

claim: It has 9 sea-facing tents (6 couple, 3 family); couple tents ~S$380–410; no eateries so guests BYO food.
quote: a total of 9 glamping tents - 3 family tents and 6 couple tents ... couple tents cost $380 per night ... and $410 on Fridays and Saturdays ... no eateries here on the island

claim: Into the Woods is closing in the first week of January 2027.
quote: Into the Woods will be operating until the first week of January 2027

claim: The SGD to EUR rate in June 2026 is about 0.67 euros per Singapore dollar.
quote: 100 Singapore Dollars is equivalent to 67.349 Euros ... the exchange rate is 0.6735 Euros per Singapore Dollar

claim: Duxton Reserve is a 49-room heritage shophouse hotel with an Opium Room and Opium Suite, from ~S$320.
quote: dramatic heritage shophouse luxury hotel has 49 rooms and starts from around SGD $320 per night ... the Opium Room and Opium Suite
